description: Get today's quantum computing papers from arXiv — no parameters needed. Use when the user asks "what's new in quantum computing?" or wants a daily paper briefing. Returns the most recent day's papers with title, authors, date, AI-generated hook (one-line summary), and tags. For date-range or topic-filtered search, use searchPapers instead. Use getPaperDetails for full abstract and analysis of a specific paper.
name: getLatestPapers
title: Today's Papers
